Subject: OrbitHealth - pricing & next steps

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of needs
- Primary workload: customer support routing + summarization + redaction pipeline
- Initial target volume: ~50M tokens/month (pilot), expected to ramp to ~300M tokens/month within 12 months if performance meets expectations
- Residency: US-only; production on dedicated pool preferred
- Security: SOC 2 + periodic audit evidence required (you mentioned procurement will want this)

Pricing/commerce signals you shared
- Target unit economics: roughly $700–$900 per 1M tokens (you mentioned $800/1M as a target)
- Procurement timeline: target decision in March; legal/procurement will own T&Cs

Next steps (ownership)
1) I’ll send a first-pass invoice estimate + cost model showing monthly line items and what reserve/commit options look like (Sean) — by EOD Monday.
2) Sofia to confirm expected pilot volume (50M vs 100M) and whether the initial pilot requires a 3-month trial or full 12-month commit (Sofia / Procurement).
3) Marissa/Monica to prep SOC2 artifacts and a short onboarding checklist for security.

Open questions
- Do you have a hard cap on first-quarter spend? (helps us recommend whether to route to Hosted vs Dedicated)
- Are there any latency SLOs we should bake into the estimate?

I’ll attach the pricing calc and a simple invoice estimate in my next email. If anything above is incorrect, flag it here and I’ll update.

Best,
Sean

Hi Sofia / team —

Attached is an updated invoice estimate and the pricing calculator based on the clarified 100M tokens/month pilot. Summary highlights below: 

High-level numbers (monthly) — 100M tokens/month baseline
- List unit price (no commit): $900 per 1M tokens -> $90,000/month
- Target customer unit price (you requested ~$800/1M): $800 per 1M tokens -> $80,000/month
- 12-month commit (recommended) reserve discount: 15% -> $68,000/month effective
- Platform fee (observability + SLA add-on if requested): $3,500/month (optional)
- Estimated total (100M tokens) with 12mo reserve & platform fee: ~$71,500/month

Notes on the model
- The attached spreadsheet (orbithealth_pricing_model_v2.xlsx) includes a model tab with curves for 50/100/250/300M monthly volumes and the pre/post-discount lines.
- We’ve separated inference unit costs (model compute + kernel optimizations) vs Redwood platform fees so you can see where volume drives margin.
- If OrbitHealth prefers a 3-month pilot without commit, we’d recommend Hosted API routing for the pilot; cost would be ~100M * $900/1M = $90k for a no-commit month.

Requested items from you
1) Confirm whether you want the 12-month reserve priced into the initial SOW vs an optional add-on.
2) Procurement: send the SOC2 link (or we can push our shared Drive link).

Attachments:
- orbithealth_pricing_model_v2.xlsx (Excel, 180KB)
- redwood_pricing_calc.csv (CSV export, 28KB)
- invoice_estimate_orbithealth_v2.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

I’ll stand by for procurement questions and can schedule a short walk-through of the spreadsheet with your finance team this week if helpful.

Best,
Sean
